boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 白米甕砲台（國家文化記憶庫/基隆市文化局列名市定古蹟，1900-1902 日治海岸型堡壘，四砲座一字排開朝港門；又稱荷蘭城）古蹟主體（OSM fort 節點；海拔誠實留空）；與既有 tw-201 基隆燈塔（0.45km）題材錯位——燈塔為現役航標古蹟主體，本點為砲台堡壘遺構主體。
boosters_i18n.en: Baimiwong Fort (city-designated historic site per the National Culture and Memory Bank/Keelung Cultural Affairs; a 1900-1902 Japanese-era coastal fortress with four gun emplacements lined up facing the harbour mouth, aka 'Holland Castle'). Disjoint from tw-201 Keelung Lighthouse 0.45 km away (active navigation-aid subject vs fortress-ruin subject).
boosters_i18n.ja: 白米甕砲台（市定古蹟、1900-1902年の歴代海岸要塞、4砲座）（OSM）。基隆燈塔とは題材が別。

penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
